query.query: Job Title: AWS DevOps Engineer Location: Remote Job Description: We are seeking a talented and experienced AWS DevOps Engineer with expertise in application migration to join our dynamic team. As an AWS DevOps Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and optimizing our cloud infrastructure and ensuring the smooth transition of applications to the AWS platform. Your primary focus will be on leveraging AWS services, implementing DevOps best practices, and utilizing Terraform for infrastructure automation. Responsibilities: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand application requirements and design scalable and reliable AWS infrastructure solutions. Develop and maintain Terraform templates for provisioning and managing AWS resources, ensuring infrastructure as code principles are followed. Utilize AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others to architect and build scalable and highly available systems. Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or AWS Code Pipeline. Ensure proper security and compliance measures are implemented for the AWS environment, following best practices and industry standards. Monitor and troubleshoot performance issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies to enhance system performance. Collaborate with development teams to automate application deployments, improve release processes, and streamline development workflows. Participate in capacity planning, cost optimization, and resource management activities to ensure efficient resource utilization. Assist in application migration from on-premises infrastructure or other cloud providers to AWS, ensuring minimal disruption and downtime. Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and provide technical guidance to team members on AWS services, DevOps practices, and infrastructure automation. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent work experience will be considered. Strong experience in designing, implementing, and managing AWS cloud infrastructure, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, and IAM. Proven experience in infrastructure automation using Terraform or similar tools. Proficient in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.) for automation and configuration management. Solid understanding of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and associated tools such as Jenkins, Git, or AWS Code Pipeline. Hands-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes. Familiarity with networking concepts, security best practices, and monitoring tools in the AWS ecosystem. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve infrastructure and application-related issues. Experience with application migration to AWS, including lift-and-shift and refactoring approaches. AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are a plus. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
